ekf_h_max.label: EKF2 horizontal error, max
ekf_h_max.description: max over the airborne samples of |EKF2 - truth| in x/y (displacements from takeoff)

ekf_h_end.label: EKF2 horizontal error, end
ekf_h_end.description: |EKF2 - truth| in x/y at the last airborne sample

ekf_h_rms.label: EKF2 horizontal RMS
ekf_h_rms.description: hypot of the x and y RMSE of EKF2 vs truth

ev_h_max.label: ZED horizontal error, max
ev_h_max.description: max horizontal error of the ZED position as EKF2 received it (lever arm removed, start-aligned)

ev_yaw_end.label: ZED yaw error, end |.|
ev_yaw_end.description: |ZED yaw - truth yaw| at the end, after removing the constant start offset

ekf_yaw_end.label: EKF2 yaw error, end |.|
ekf_yaw_end.description: |EKF2 yaw - truth yaw| at the end

yaw_step_worst.label: worst yaw slip per rotation
yaw_step_worst.description: largest yaw error a single rotation (|yaw rate| > 0.3 rad/s) added to the ZED

yaw_rate_peak.label: peak yaw rate
yaw_rate_peak.description: peak |yaw rate| over the rotations (set by MC_YAWRATE_MAX)

latency.label: residual EV latency
latency.description: best lag of the EV velocity against truth (+-300 ms search); residual after the bridge restamp, should be ~0

vel_rmse.label: ZED velocity RMSE (x,y)
vel_rmse.description: ZED body velocity RMSE, x and y combined per axis (hypot / sqrt 2)

vel_scale_x.label: ZED velocity scale x
vel_scale_x.description: least-squares slope ZED vs true camera velocity, body x (1 = right scale and frame)

lever_fit.label: lever-arm fit |.|
lever_fit.description: |true camera offset - EKF2_EV_POS| in x/y fitted from the hover yaw steps

pos_noise.label: ZED position noise (2 s HP)
pos_noise.description: short-term ZED position noise: std of the residual after a 2 s moving average (worse axis)

gap_slip.label: worst slip at a gap
gap_slip.description: largest position-error change across a frame gap

gap_yaw_slip.label: worst yaw slip at a gap
gap_yaw_slip.description: largest yaw-error change across a frame gap

pose_jump.label: worst pose jump (no gap)
pose_jump.description: largest ZED position step (> 0.10 m off truth between two samples, no gap)

tilt_end.label: ZED frame tilt, end
tilt_end.description: ZED roll/pitch vs truth at the end (world-frame tilt of the IMU-less sim SDK)

ev_pos_fused.label: EV position fused
ev_pos_fused.description: fraction of EV position samples EKF2 fused

flow_fused.label: optical flow fused
flow_fused.description: fraction of optical-flow samples EKF2 fused
